paragraphs: On Saturday morning, Lily and Dad went to the pier. The sun was bright. The pier was busy, and Lily was excited. She wanted to send a postcard to Grace in Singapore. A small shop near the water sold postcards. The pictures showed boats, fish, and the sea. The woman in the shop smiled at Lily. Lily chose a picture of a blue boat, and Dad bought a stamp.

Outside the shop, a taxi stopped at the road. Two passengers got out with big bags. They walked to the boats. The engine of a boat made a loud noise, and the boat left the pier. Then an ambulance came down the road with its lights on. The cars stopped, and the ambulance went past. Dad held Lily's hand until the road was quiet again.

Lily sat on a bench next to the shop. She took a pen from her bag and wrote the postcard. "Dear Grace, I am at the water with Dad today. The sun is hot, and the sea is blue. Many boats leave from here, and the passengers wait in a line. A taxi brought two passengers, and then an ambulance went past. The boat engine is very loud! I am excited, because this card is for you. Best wishes, Lily"

"Where can we post it?" asked Lily. "There is a red post box at the end of the pier," said Dad. They walked there together. Lily read the card one more time. Lily put the stamp on the card and posted it. "It will arrive in a few days," said Dad.
Lily looked at the blue boats on the water. "Grace will have a picture of the sea," she said. "I hope she likes it." Dad smiled and bought two small bags of fruit for the walk home.
